correctness.rationale: Exact last-noise-reset decomposition yields bivariate Gaussian covariance integrals; a unique Laplace saddle determines the conditional Gaussian age and velocity, the short-age rescaling plus published density tail produces the local reset-age measure, and stationarity of the continuous position forces j(x)=0. The rare inward velocity weighted by its 1/|x| mass cancels the positive bulk drift. Independent covariance quadratures and finite-saddle integrations check constants and normalizations. The proof does not infer infinite claims from finite tests.

value.rationale: The fixed-parameter active-trap stationary state has an observable far-tail mean-versus-typical-velocity paradox. An exact Gaussian conditional velocity and the previously hidden 1/|x| young-reset population quantify two competing physical transport mechanisms; the latter is necessary to reconstruct the exact zero current and is not a routine exercise in marginal tail evaluation.
